cues.en: Given how important a good stoplist is in the real world, it's worth your time to actually go and implement one.
cues.zh: 既然好的排除清單在實務上這麼重要，值得花時間真正實作一個。

cues.en: Try modifying our RBM example from earlier in the course to filter out any movies that contain words in a stoplist from the training stage entirely.
cues.zh: 試著修改先前課程中的 RBM 範例，在訓練階段就完全濾除標題中包含排除清單詞彙的電影。

cues.en: Your goal is to make sure that our recommender system doesn't even know these titles exist.
cues.zh: 目標是確保推薦系統根本不知道這些作品存在。

cues.en: To do so, you'll have to modify the RBMAlgorithm class to apply this stoplist as it's building up the training matrix.
cues.zh: 為此，必須修改 RBMAlgorithm 類別，在建構訓練矩陣時套用排除清單。

cues.en: That's probably the only hint you need.
cues.zh: 你需要的提示大概就這麼多。

cues.en: And when we come back, I'll show you how I did it.
cues.zh: 回來之後，我會示範我的做法。
